from openpyxl import load_workbook

SRC = "sales_data.xlsx"

ws = wb.active

header_row = 1

    for name in names:
        for h, col in headers.items():
            if h is not None and name.lower() in str(h).lower():
                return col
    raise KeyError(f"None of {names} found in headers: {list(headers)}")

profit_col = find_col("profit")
revenue_col = find_col("sales", "revenue")

new_header.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for r in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    pc = ws.cell(row=r, column=profit_col)
    rc = ws.cell(row=r, column=revenue_col)
    if pc.value is None and rc.value is None:
        continue
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col)
    cell.value = f"={pc.coordinate}/{rc.coordinate}"
    cell.number_format = "0.0%"

wb.save(SRC)
print("Saved. New column at", ws.cell(row=header_row, column=new_col).coordinate, "rows:", ws.max_row)
